children: First Northwest Bancorp agreed to pay $1.3 million to settle and dismiss litigation involving its subsidiary First Fed Bank.
First Fed Bank and Socotra REIT I settled claims on Sept 15, 2026, resolving a complaint filed Oct 17, 2025.
The Bank will make a $1.3 million cash payment within 30 days in exchange for a full release and dismissal with prejudice.
Settlement resolves alleged misrepresentation, fraud, conversion and Washington Consumer Protection Act claims tied to a commercial loan.
Company states settlement is a compromise, not an admission of liability, and avoids further litigation costs and distraction.
